message.content:
Here is the audit of visual differences between the original (Image 1) and the clone (Image 2):

**1. Dashboard UI Component (Right Side)**
*   **Data & Content Mismatch (High Severity):** The dashboard screenshot in the clone is a completely different state/version than the original. 
    *   **List Items:** The original shows 6 rows of data (Space Exploration, Intel Comunicaciones, test@gmail.com, etc.). The clone shows only 3 rows with different names (jane.doe, Arrow Corp, sarah.chen).
    *   **Sidebar Selection:** In the original, "Visitors" is the active/selected menu item. In the clone, "Activity" appears to be the active item.
    *   **Header Stats:** The visitor/company counts in the top right of the dashboard card differ.
    *   **Progress Bars:** The confidence bars in the original are mostly teal/green. In the clone, they are mixed (one is yellow/orange).
    *   **Status Badges:** The original uses grey text for status ("Inactive"). The clone uses solid yellow/orange pill badges.

**2. Typography & Copy (Body Text)**
*   **"Real-Time Dashboard" Description (Medium Severity):**
    *   **Original:** Ends with "...beautiful live **dashboard**."
    *   **Clone:** Ends with "...beautiful live **dashboard:**" (Includes an extra colon at the end).

**3. Pricing Section Badges (Bottom Right)**
*   **"BEST VALUE" Badge Styling (Low Severity):**
    *   **Original:** Text is all uppercase ("BEST VALUE"). Background is a solid, vibrant yellow/gold.
    *   **Clone:** Text is Title Case ("Best value"). Background color appears slightly lighter or more muted.

**4. Layout & Spacing (Pricing Cards)**
*   **Card Content Visibility (Medium Severity):**
    *   **Original:** The pricing cards ("Traditional IP-Lookup Tools" and "Pixelco") show only the titles.
    *   **Clone:** Subtitle text is visible below the titles (e.g., "Company-level only" and "Individual email identification..."). This changes the vertical height and layout balance of this section compared to the original.

**Summary:**
The clone fails to match the specific visual state of the dashboard component (High severity), contains a text punctuation error in the feature list (Medium), and displays extra content in the pricing section that alters the layout (Medium).
